note: Triage 02:18 CST Nov 14: tracker: the coordinator. Build lane: test-author, builder, reviewer (a tool the batch runner relies on; the lane says whether it touches a guard or check verdict). Done check: the tool runs continuous dry folds behind the next-in-line PR, runs the fast checks (fast-checks-before-ready) every round, posts per-batch numbers (members in, members left out, clash rate, dry-round minutes, lint minutes, CI minutes), and is proven on a dry run on a real queue with no push; then a review after 3 batches against per-lane merges: does it beat per-lane on measured numbers. The switch from per-lane to the train waits for that review; until then runner 10 merges per lane by priority.
